title: Hide That Bedrock
description: This ResourcePack Hides Bedrock So Your Bedrock and Cords Won't Get Leaked
body:
Hide That Bedrock
A simple, lightweight utility resource pack that completely hides the ugly, noisy vanilla bedrock texture and replaces it with a clean, solid pitch-black block featuring subtle, dark grey highlights on the edges. Perfect for custom maps, technical builders, and players who want a sleek, modern look for their void perimeters and nether roofs without sacrificing block definition.

## Key Features
Minimalist Aesthetic: Swaps out the chaotic vanilla bedrock texture for a solid, dark theme that blends perfectly into the void.

3D Block Definition: Features precise, very dark grey edge highlighting so you can still easily see the corners, depth, and layout of the blocks.

Zero Performance Impact: Extremely lightweight 16x16 optimized textures ensure your frame rates stay perfectly smooth, even when rendering massive bedrock perimeters.

100% Vanilla Compatible: Works completely fine right out of the box on standard vanilla clients. No OptiFine, Fabric API, or backend mods required.

## How to Install
Download the .zip file for your Minecraft version.

Open Minecraft, go to Options > Resource Packs > Open Pack Folder.

Drop the downloaded file into the folder.

Activate Hide That Bedrock in-game and move it to the top of your resource pack list!

## Categories & Details
Category: Tweaks, Utility, Simplistic

Resolution: 16x16 (Vanilla Friendly)

Compatibility: Works across all modern versions of Minecraft Java Edition.

Note: This pack only alters the visual texture of the bedrock block. It does not change any vanilla game mechanics, block properties, or drop behavior—making it completely safe to use on vanilla survival servers and SMPs!
